subject: SIG evidence package and attestation timeline — MedSys RFP
messages:
From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@medsys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG kickoff & evidence ask for RFP (MedSys)

Ben —

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. MedSys is moving quickly on our RFP and the security team asked me to consolidate a SIG completion plan. We need the following artifacts to attach to our procurement packet: the latest SOC 2 report, an executive summary of the most recent penetration test, ISO statement(s), and the security overview deck.

Can you confirm which items you can share by end of next week and whether anything requires an NDA/attestation? If a DocuSign attestation is preferred for SOC 2, send the link and we'll route it to the reviewers.

Ideal timeline from our side: initial artifacts by 3/21, procurement review 3/22–3/28, exec decision before month-end. Please include any limitations (redactions, scope differences).

Thanks —
Ari
Ari Kaplan
Security Review Lead, MedSys Health
[phone]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@medsys.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff & evidence ask for RFP (MedSys)

Ari —

Appreciate the clear timeline. We can get a SOC 2 PDF and our ISO statements over quickly; the pen-test executive summary is currently in final QA with our security team and I expect a draft by Monday (3/19). Laura and Rishi are copied to coordinate delivery and DocuSign if needed.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2 Type II (period ending 2027-12-31) — can provide PDF and an attestation via DocuSign.
- ISO 27001 statement — public statement + formal PDF.
- Pen-test — internal vendor completed in Feb; exec summary draft by 3/19, final by 3/21. There may be a small number of redactions for customer names in the appendix.
- Security deck v2 — we can share the 14-slide exec deck.

I'll put together a single Drive folder and a DocuSign request. If MedSys requires an NDA for the pen-test appendix, flag that and we'll route the redacted appendix under NDA.

Action: Rishi — please assemble SOC2, ISO, and deck into the Drive folder. Laura — coordinate the pen-test summary QA and confirm any redactions.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[mobile]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SIG kickoff & evidence ask for RFP (MedSys)

Folks —

Uploading initial artifacts to the shared folder now. Attached in the folder: redwood_soc2_report_2027.pdf, iso27001_statement_2027.pdf, and security_overview_deck_v2.pptx (exec deck). The pen-test exec summary is attached as a draft: pen_test_exec_summary_draft_2028.pdf.

Notes on pen-test: vendor found a handful of medium findings; no criticals. We recommend redacting customer IDs in Appendix B before public distribution; the exec summary excludes exploitation details and is safe to share with procurement. For full appendix access we will require a standard NDA or a redaction request form.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExample
DocuSign for SOC 2 attestation: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC1234

Laura — please confirm expected delivery for the final pen-test summary set (appendix + remediation notes).

Rishi
Security Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@medsys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff & evidence ask for RFP (MedSys)

Ben / Rishi —

Thanks — the draft artifacts look good for procurement review. A couple of quick clarifying items from our security team:

1) For the SOC 2 PDF, can you confirm the control categories covered (CC1–CC7) and whether the scope included hosting in us-west-2?
2) The pen-test draft is fine for scoring, but procurement will need a written attestation that there are no outstanding critical vulnerabilities and an estimated time-to-remediate for medium issues. Can you provide that attestation text or sign off in DocuSign?
3) We may need a separate redacted appendix for vendor names — procurement prefers redactions rather than an NDA unless the appendix contains customer PII.

Procurement note: we need final artifacts by COB 3/21 to keep the review window. If you can get the signed DocuSign and the brief attestation, we can move to contract review on 3/22.

—Ari

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@medsys.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff & evidence ask for RFP (MedSys)

Ari —

Thanks for the clarifying questions. Quick status update (delivered to Drive and DocuSign):
- SOC 2: redwood_soc2_report_2027.pdf (controls CC1–CC7; scope includes production services hosted in us-west-2). SOC 2 attestation request sent via DocuSign (link above).
- Pen test: pen_test_exec_summary_draft_2028.pdf (no criticals outstanding). We added a short attestation paragraph in the folder confirming "no critical or high-severity open vulnerabilities as of 2028-03-21; medium items have expected remediation between 2–8 weeks depending on complexity." If procurement prefers, we'll sign the attestation via DocuSign — please confirm and we'll route.
- Redactions: vendor/customer identifiers removed from Appendix B for the version in Drive. If you need the full appendix, we will provide it under a simple NDA (template available).
- Security deck: security_overview_deck_v2.pptx delivered.

Next steps: if DocuSign attestation works, sign and notify procurement; otherwise tell us the exact attestation language and we'll add it to the DocuSign envelope. Happy to schedule a 30-minute debrief tomorrow morning if your reviewers want to walk through the artifacts.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[mobile]

Attachments referenced: redwood_soc2_report_2027.pdf; pen_test_exec_summary_draft_2028.pdf; iso27001_statement_2027.pdf; security_overview_deck_v2.pptx
